title: Criteria registry (shared/criteria.json)
description: Single authored definition of the seven SIR criteria and the controlled vocabularies shared by backend and frontend. Structure is validated by JSON Schema; two invariants are enforced by the loader because JSON Schema cannot express them: criteria keys and order values must be unique and cover 1..7, and every criterion must satisfy 0 <= indifference_threshold < preference_threshold <= 1.

version.description: Registry version; bumped when a criterion, direction, unit, or default threshold changes.

criteria.description: Exactly seven criteria in display order (order 1..7). Adding a criterion requires a registry version bump, a database migration, and regenerated frontend/backend constants.

key.description: Stable API key used in weights, contributions, and the database.

order.description: Display order; must be unique and cover 1..7.

label_ru.description: Russian label shown in the interface.

direction.description: min: lower is better (price, weight); max: higher is better.

storage_field.description: Column name on device_models holding the raw value.

indifference_threshold.description: q: normalized difference at or below which alternatives are indifferent. Default 0.

preference_threshold.description: p: normalized difference at or above which one alternative is strictly preferred. Default 1; must exceed the indifference threshold.

display_decimals.description: Decimals used when formatting the raw value in the interface.
